stem:
READ the following quotation.

Good teachers know how to bring out the best in students.

—Charles Kuralt

THINK carefully about the best teacher you know.

WRITE about the best teacher you know. Tell who it is and explain the characteristics that make this person a good teacher.

Be sure to —

• clearly state your central idea
• organize your writing
• develop your writing in detail
• choose your words carefully
• use correct spelling, capitalization, punctuation, grammar, and sentences
visual_elements: Good teachers know how to bring out the best in students. —Charles Kuralt
